data.description: Implement SearchLatencyBenchmark measuring find_documents_for_query() p50/p90/p99 latency at various corpus sizes. Include cold vs warm cache comparison. First checkpoint for query benchmarks.

properties.retrospective:
Implemented 2 query benchmarks:
- SearchLatencyBenchmark: p50/p90/p99 latency percentiles, cold cache, QPS
- ColdWarmCacheBenchmark: cold vs warm cache comparison (~2.5x speedup)

Results: p50=0.07ms, QPS=10K+, all thresholds pass.

data.title: Stage 1: Basic search latency benchmarks
